shared_image_compatibility: research-only; a rebuilt image and a matching source receipt are required

shared_runtime_receipt.local_image_identity: Exact sha256 image config ID; not a registry manifest digest
shared_runtime_receipt.qualification: CPU source and file witnesses permit an explicit research launch; they do not qualify GPU serving behavior.

shared_sources.source_publication: Public source bases plus the common recipe patches; no private source archives are required.

shared_image_requirements.required_behavior: Admit TP2/DCP1 with BF16 GLM5Next, V2 runner, 8192-token chunks, aligned prefix caching, retention interval 0, and static MTP3. Preserve four-checkpoint ownership and continuation in the common source.
Use world_size=2 for row ownership, admission votes, and NCCL reduce-scatter/all-gather. Preserve the TP4 implementation and its stream lifetime checks.
Set 0 for TP2 to preserve the measured sequential KDA adapter behavior. Leave the common TP4 source's default 1 unchanged.
The consumer and kernel must agree on export capacity and padded metadata. Preserve four-destination export support; do not overwrite it with the measured two-destination source.

Managed persistent CUDA allocation for target and MTP checkpoint tensors, direct checkpoint I/O, and no shared allocation of nonpersistent runtime buffers. Select VLLM_PLUGINS=b12x_loader, --load-format b12x, and --model-loader-extra-config with allocation=managed. The shared loader retains pinned_wc when the option is absent and records the selected allocation in model._b12x_loader_storage.

Select the complete content-bound TP2 bundle before B12X imports, use two paths at HCA indices 0/2, and retain size-aware CUDA grids with independent barrier counters. All-reduce limit 16 MiB; all-gather limit 16 MiB per input shard.

The shared image selects source-verified NCCL 2.30.7 at /opt/sparkring/nccl-pci/libnccl.so.2.30.7 with extended IPv4 GIDs, preserved PCI domains, and routing diagnostics enabled. Use exact-match p0 device names on both PCI domains and eight channels. This prospective combination needs separate GPU qualification; the reference deployment used NCCL 2.30.4.
Disabled for this profile. Packaging SparkCache in the shared image must not add --kv-transfer-config. This TP2 checkpoint/source/transport combination needs separate cache qualification.

reference_trial.measurement: Both ranks completed startup. One arithmetic smoke request returned 17 + 25 = 42 followed by FINAL=42.
reference_trial.conclusion: The separate reference source image started this bounded configuration and answered one arithmetic request.
limitations: The KV token count is a reference allocator estimate, not a measured request capacity; the per-request context limit remains 262144.
The reference trial stopped both host memory guards. The public launcher requires an active 2 GiB guard.
Performance, sustained memory stability, and full-context serving are not qualified for this checkpoint and configuration.
Four image inputs are admitted, but image accuracy is unqualified; video and SparkCache are disabled.
Reference model config/index hashes matched and all indexed shards existed; full shard hashes were not recomputed during the checkpoint swap.

required_shared_image_checks: Source hashes and transport activation must match the profile receipt before model/GPU initialization, including Python workers.
CPU coalescing and mHC checks must cover TP2/DCP1 and retained TP4 paths on the exact common source.
Validate four-checkpoint producer/consumer shapes and managed target/MTP loader ownership on the composed source.
Verify loaded NCCL identity, B12X API version, selected transport origin, and paired rank settings in the image.
Run correctness and bounded serving comparisons on the new image before using the measured TP2 result as its qualification.
